sloka: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण अङ्गदः कपिकुञ्जरः ।उदतिष्ठत दीप्ताक्षो दण्डाहत इवोरगः ।। ६.५४.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: nimeṣāntaramātreṇa aṅgadaḥ kapikuñjaraḥ ।udatiṣṭhata dīptākṣo daṇḍāhata ivoragaḥ ।। 6.54.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty son of Vali lopped off the great head of Vajradamshtra's with a sharpened stainless sword.
